extensions.name: Archive Audio (CC & Public Domain)
extensions.author: afrolord892-ai
extensions.description: Finds exact-duration audio recordings in the Internet Archive and offers only items carrying an explicit Public Domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA license. Supports streaming and offline audio downloads.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Stream an exact-match recording with an explicit permissive license

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Offer offline copies only when the item declares a permissive license

actions.name: network
actions.why: Search licensed Internet Archive audio and read its item metadata

extensions.changelog: First release. Audio streaming and downloads are limited to exact-duration items with a verified Public Domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA license URL.
